bought.spec: compression, 304 stainless, wire 0.3, OD 3.0, free 30; four per cartridge (two in each bolt)
bought.check: on a kitchen scale: 1.7..2.2 N at 14.6 long; fully closed it must be 9.0 long or less (E 0.127 N/mm, 28 coils)

bought.note: female on the pack's lead, male in the collar and carrier

cartridge: 1 press a magnet into each bolt's underside
2 push each bolt in through its wall hole from outside (the second turned half round)
3 drop the stop bar down across the rib into both bolts
4 four springs, a guide pin inside each, squeezed and dropped into the bolts' slots from above
5 pack down into the cartridge over them (the keeper lips snap over it); its XT60W-F into the keyed pocket at the lead end, two M3 set screws
receiver: 6 (when the receiver's run has passed) the two TPU seat strips into their recesses under the deck, between their keys
7 XT60W-M glued into the plug collar (after the measurement), laid in the plug carrier, cap on
8 carrier and cap onto the lead-end bosses; the receiver's M3 mount bolts from below clamp them
